authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6624 dravati explicitly gives the -ḍ extension dauṛ-/doṛ- run, including Marwari doṛṇo. These survey imperative and verbal endings attach to that extension; aspiration may reflect dhāvati influence and remains qualified. Reviewed comparator: jaun doḍo “run!, he ran” (f_dnzebnlss433m). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
